item.title: Russia's view amid Ukraine's strikes and Zelenskyy's growing rift with the U.S.
item.description: Russian authorities say Ukraine struck a major oil refinery southeast of Moscow Thursday. The strike was in response to Russia's attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
item.content:encoded: Russian authorities say Ukraine struck a major oil refinery southeast of Moscow Thursday. The strike was in response to Russia's attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Charles Maynes

item.title: How Putin may react to the rift between the U.S. and Ukraine
item.description: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.
item.content:encoded: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.

item.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
item.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
item.description: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

item.title: Ukraine says its Starshield access is back
item.description: Ukraine says its access to SpaceX's Starshield has been restored. It's the system the country uses for its offensive drone attacks on Russia.

item.title: Rep. Mike Quigley, D-Ill., on reports Ukraine's Starshield access was restricted
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Democratic Rep. Mike Quigley of Illinois about reports that SpaceX temporarily restricted access to its Starshield in Ukraine, affecting the country's war efforts.

item.title: School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
item.description: The roof of a private school collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday, killing at least 28 children and a female teacher and injuring more than 50 other people.
item.content:encoded:
The roof of a private school collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday, killing at least 28 children and a female teacher and injuring more than 50 other people.

item.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
item.description: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

item.title: Zelenskyy sits down with NPR. And, Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has a sit-down interview with NPR as Russia's full-scale invasion nears the 5-year mark. And, Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer.
